notes_for_editor: Only the Eastern US Forest Lookouts index places a lookout here. A 2016 Florida tower list held in the crawl cache, whose source has no stable URL and so is not cited, gives a 'berrydale' entry at 30.90333, -87.02472 in Santa Rosa County, about 100 m from the record's point. Do not confuse with the Berrydale Volunteer Fire Department's planned fire training tower, which a 2025 county bid notice describes; that is a modern training structure, not a lookout. No NHLR, FFLOS or Florida Forest Service record was reachable. Build date, agency, height, staffing and current condition are unknown. The map position the story cites is an embedded map point in the page HTML at 30.9025, -87.0253 (zoom 10); it is not in the visible text, so it has no quote in evidence.
